# help showfileshare
showfileshare - Display information of all fileshares or a specific fileshares in a system.

SYNTAX
    showfileshare [<filesystem_name> [<share_name>]]

DESCRIPTION
    The showfileshare command displays information about all the fileshares or a specific fileshare in a system.

AUTHORITY
    Any role in the system

OPTIONS
    -allnames
        Shows both the shortened and full fileshare names.

    -notree
        Do not display fileshare names in tree format.

    -snap
        Displays all the fileshares in the snapshot tree for the specified
        base fileshare.

SPECIFIERS
    <filesystem_name>
        Specifies the filesystem name whose fileshare needs to be displayed.

    <share_name>
        Specifies the fileshare name whose information will be displayed.
	If not specified, configuration information for all fileshares in the system is displayed.

NOTES
    Long names can cause the display to be very wide. Use -shortnames
    to display shortened 31 character names for objects. Use the setclienv
    command to set shortnames to 1. The -shortnames option is also set to 1
    if the CLI was started with the -shortnames option, or if the CLI was
    started with the TPDSHORTNAMES environment variable set. Run "cli -h"
    and "setclienv -h" for details of the environment variables.

EXAMPLES
    The following example shows all the fileshares on the system.

	 cli% showfileshare

     The following example shows demo_share fileshare in the demo_fs filesystem.

	  cli% showfileshare demo_fs demo_share
